text:
Maya: Heads up  vendor ClaimNet reports a customer posted two identical charges for invoice inv_6087. They attached a bank screenshot.

Billing Bot: Notice: Invoice inv_6087 status=paid, settled_amount=USD 4,320, settlement_id=stl_6087. No duplicate settlement found.

Ethan: Can we get the card last4 and gateway events?

Maya: last4=6678. Vendor screenshot timestamps: 03/03 09:12 and 03/04 01:08.

Carl: Gateway events: auth 03/03T09:11 -> capture 03/03T09:12 -> clearing 03/04T01:07 (network posting). Only one capture id cap_6610.

Nina: Banks sometimes show a pending auth then a final charge as two lines. Need vendor to confirm which line is posted vs pending.

Risk Bot: Automated: score=0.08 low fraud. No velocity.

Maya: Vendor says both lines look posted on their customer's bank UI. They want refund immediately.

Ethan: Legal needs: merchant descriptor, settlement id, auth id, customer consent, invoice PDF, webhook traces.

Legal - Chen: Do not refund yet. Assemble representment packet. If vendor insists, offer a $25 goodwill credit.

Maya: Uploaded invoice & signed order to secure drive. Link: https://internal.redwood/secure/flows/inv6087 (SAML).

Carl: Found a duplicated webhook retry around 03/04 01:06 but idempotency prevented double capture. Attaching trace.

Ethan: Good. Prepare bank-friendly explanation showing auth vs final posting + idempotency header. That usually resolves.

Maya: I'll send explainer to ClaimNet and cc vendor's payments team. Offer $25 credit while they wait.

Legal - Chen: I'll draft the representment packet template in case of chargeback.

Billing Bot: Reminder: refunds > $1k require finance approval. Amount here is $4,320.

Maya: Noted. Will not refund until vendor provides processor refs proving a second settled charge. Update here when they reply.

ClaimNet (external): Sent processor refs: pr_7710 (VOID) and pr_7711 (SETTLED). We'll email full logs.

Maya: Thanks. Once we confirm pr_7710 is void, we'll close with vendor. 

Ethan: Packet draft ready at /secure/flows/inv6087/representment_draft.pdf. Legal please review.

Legal - Chen: Reviewing now. Will finalize within 2 hours.

Maya: Closing loop once vendor confirms bank reclassification.
